## What

- Summarize the specific changes made in this pull request.
- List modified components, added files, or updated APIs.

## Why

- Explain the motivation or business/technical problem behind these changes.
- Link relevant issues or tickets (e.g., `Closes #123`).

## How

- Describe the technical implementation strategy and architecture choices.
- Note any critical edge cases handled or trade-offs made.

## Test

- List clear, step-by-step instructions to verify the changes.
- Mention unit tests, integration tests, or manual testing performed.
